article.title: transcosmos宣布採用Profound，支援日本及多語AI搜尋優化
article.title_en: transcosmos adopts Profound to support AI search optimization in Japan and across languages
article.summary: transcosmos宣布將Profound用作trans-GEO的分析與衡量基礎，把AI搜尋觀察連到網站及內容優化。
article.summary_en: transcosmos announced plans to use Profound as trans-GEO's analytics and measurement foundation, linking AI-search observations with website and content work.
highlights: 追蹤品牌在AI答案中的出現、引用及推薦，支援診斷。
服務包括內容、資訊架構及網站優化，亦涵蓋多語言。
highlights_en: Brand appearances, citations and recommendations support diagnostics.
Services cover content, information architecture and website optimization across languages.
article.why: AI答案觀察加入網站診斷後，服務團隊可按語言及問題找出資訊缺口，決定先修訂哪些頁面與內容結構。
article.why_en: AI-answer observations can help service teams identify language- and query-specific gaps and prioritize pages and information architecture.
article.next_step: 選一個日文產品頁及對應英文頁，列出相同購買問題，核對品牌引用與頁面資料差異，再排定內容修訂次序。
article.next_step_en: Compare one Japanese product page with its English counterpart against matching purchase questions, then prioritize revisions from citation and information gaps.
article.detail: 生成式引擎優化是讓公司資料更容易被AI搜尋理解及引用的內容與網站工作。這次屬transcosmos服務採用公告，與Profound早前的Teams介面及亞太辦公室消息不同。編輯建議把觀察時點、語言與實際頁面一併保存，讓改版前後可以比較；公司對準確度及品牌可見度的描述，不能直接當成已證明的新增客戶或保證推薦。
article.detail_en: Generative engine optimization concerns how AI search understands and cites company information. This service-adoption announcement differs from earlier Profound interface and office news. Retain observation dates, languages and page versions for comparisons. Supplier claims about accuracy or visibility do not establish new customers or guaranteed recommendations.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
